# Angel Guild — Help Us Get the Word Out on Angel and the Badman


by Angel | September 22, 2026


First off, thanks for being an Angel Guild member. You're the reason this movie exists and we’d love **a short video from you talking about it.**


---


#### **Setting Up Your Phone (about 5 minutes)**


**Hold your phone the tall way.** Portrait, not landscape. These videos are going on Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook. The tall shape is what plays there.


**Find good light.** Sit facing a window during the daytime and you're golden. Don't sit with a window behind you, or you'll show up as a shadow. Outside works too, just not squinting into the sun.


**Prop the phone up so it stands on its own.** A stack of books, a shelf, a windowsill. Anything that puts the camera about arm's length from your face.


**Frame your face in the top half of the screen.** Leave a little room above your head. We don't need to see much below your chest.


**Film somewhere quiet.** No TV in the background, no dishwasher running. The phone's built-in mic is fine. You don't need anything extra.


**Do a 5-second test.** Watch it back. If your voice sounds clear and your face is easy to see, you're ready to go.


---


#### **What to Say (about 30 to 60 seconds on camera)**


Talk like you're telling a friend about a movie you're excited about.


Here's a simple 3-part structure:


##### **1. The Hook (first 5 seconds)**


Grab attention with one line. Something personal. A few examples:


-


*"I used to grow up watching westerns with my father?"*


-


*“I got to see this film early and it is a must-see on the big screen”*


-


*"They finally made a real Western again."*


-


*"I've been in the Angel Guild for \[X years\], and this one might be my favorite yet."*


-


*"I helped greenlight this movie. And now it's in theaters."*


##### **2. Why You're Excited (about 20 to 40 seconds)**


Say the movie name clearly, **Angel and the Badman** , and share why it hits you. Pick 2 or 3 of these to touch on. Don't try to say them all:


-


It's a **retelling of the 1947 John Wayne classic**


-


**Tommy Lee Jones** is in it (the Marshal)


-


It's about **redemption, family, and faith** . The good stuff.


-


You **helped bring this film to theaters** as a guild member, and that means something


-


Who you're **going to see it with** (spouse, kids, grandkids, dad, church group)


##### **3. The Ask (last 5 to 10 seconds)**


Close with the invitation. Say the date clearly:


-


*"In theaters October 9th. Go get your tickets."*


-


*"October 9th. Bring your family."*


-


*"It's out October 9th. Don't miss it."*


---


#### **A Few Final Tips**


-


**Be yourself.** Don't put on a "camera voice." The whole point is that it feels real.


-


**Look at the lens** (the little circle at the top of your phone), not at yourself on the screen.


-


**Smile.** Warmth carries through the screen.


-


**One take is fine.** If it feels natural, send it. If it doesn't, try one more time. Max.


-


**If you flub, laugh it off and keep going.** That stuff actually plays great.


-


**Don't spoil the ending.** You've seen more than most people will. Keep the surprises intact.


-


**Under a minute is perfect.** Shorter beats longer every time.
